subject: Next steps: demo capacity, infra intro & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Chloe / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call earlier — this was really helpful. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: real-time document summarization for trader desk workflows (low latency, on-prem for PII).
- Expected monthly usage: ~30M tokens; peak concurrency ~60 concurrent sessions.
- Compliance: SOC2 + data residency in us-east required.

Two asks as we prioritize next steps:
1) Can we schedule a technical deep-dive focused on latency (p99) and on-prem deployment model?
2) I need an initial procurement checklist to share with our vendor management team.

I can make time Tue/Wed next week (July 21-22) in the afternoon (EST). If you need procurement folks involved, I'll loop Tom (procurement lead).

Attaching the RFP extract and a short inventory of our current infra.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Integrations — FinLytics
(alicia.gomez@finlytics.com)
(attachment: FinLytics_RFP_excerpt.pdf - application/pdf)
From: chloe.martin@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Alicia — great to meet you on the call. Short response and proposed plan: 

Thanks for the summary — that aligns with what we heard. Proposed next steps:

1) Technical deep-dive (60 min): demo of a baseline on-prem runner + p99 latency testing plan.
   - Proposed times (EST): Tue 21 Jul 2:00–3:00pm, Wed 22 Jul 3:30–4:30pm.
2) Procurement checklist: we’ll send a 1-page procurement pack (SOW, support tiers, hosting options) before the meeting.
3) Security/evidence: we’ll include a short SOC2 evidence index and our standard data flow diagram.

Kimberly (cc) will own the procurement packet. Can you confirm which time works and whether Tom should be added to the call?

Attachments: demo-runbook.pdf (runbook outline we’ll demo from).

Action items for us:
- Kimberly: prepare procurement one-pager + pricing envelope (by Mon 20 Jul).
- Me: draft technical agenda and invite Sean from Platform for infra questions.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
(attachment: demo-runbook.pdf - application/pdf)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>, chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps

Thanks — looping in Sean (platform lead) to cover on-prem constraints and capacity routing. A few procurement notes up-front:

- For on-prem deployments we typically validate GPU counts and network egress patterns; if you can share a short inventory (GPU types, cluster size) that’ll speed sizing.
- For reserved capacity pricing we’ll propose two profiles: (1) burst-friendly with autoscale; (2) locked commit for predictable unit economics.
- I’ll attach the procurement one-pager and a sample SOW draft after internal review (target: Mon 20 Jul EOD).

Sean — can you confirm whether we should allocate a pre-demo sandbox for a p99 benchmark or run the test on FinLytics infra? Chloe suggested a baseline on our runner then a handoff.

Proposed preferred slot: Wed 22 Jul 3:30–4:30pm EST.

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(attachment: procurement-onepager-draft.docx - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-17T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps

Chloe / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed 22 Jul 3:30–4:30pm EST works for us; I’ve looped Tom (procurement) to review the one-pager ahead of the call.

Tom — brief context: Redwood will demo an on-prem baseline and walk through procurement options (reserve vs burst). I’ve attached the RFP excerpt in case you want to pre-screen.

Two small asks before Wed:
- Tom: could you send any mandatory contract clauses or PO timeline constraints so Kimberly can adapt the SOW?
- Chloe / Sean: can you confirm whether the p99 benchmark will require us to provision anything on our side? If so, we’ll try to have a small GPU test node available.

Looking forward — Alicia

Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Integrations — FinLytics
alicia.gomez@finlytics.com
